findings.claim: Settled: a source must exist on disk, found by review_due._resolve's candidate order (concept folder, bundle, repo root, leading / as bundle-relative, .md added). Git is not needed and files not yet added are accepted. Row r3 tests both the untracked-accepted case and the missing-refused case.
Settled: kmctl new handoff refuses --source, the same way other kinds refuse --key. Row r3 tests the refusal.
